## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `develop`, and the commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `pnpm verify:fast` passes (and `pnpm verify` for larger changes)
- [ ] Every new or changed user-facing string exists in both `messages/hu.json` and `messages/en.json`
- [ ] UI changes have Storybook stories and a `play` or Vitest test
- [ ] User-visible changes have a scenario in `docs/manual-qa-test-plan.md`
- [ ] No new dependency or migration, or it was agreed in the issue
- [ ] Screenshots (light and dark theme) are attached for UI changes
